metrics.outside_room_polygon_exact: Every room whose mask does not intersect the edit region is matched one-to-one by label and IoU >= 0.5 with boundary Hausdorff distance <= 0.5 px.
metrics.outside_wall_exact: Wall support outside the edit region, changed pixels, and a two-pixel dilation is exactly equal; segment support is also checked with a 0.5-pixel directed tolerance.
metrics.outside_opening_exact: Unaffected openings form a same-type bijection with center distance <= 1.0 px.
metrics.outside_edge_exact: The room adjacency set among unaffected rooms is identical under the room mapping.
metrics.locality_violation_area: Symmetric-difference area of matched unaffected rooms and buffered wall segments, normalized by their total area.

attack_suite: Move one unaffected room polygon vertex by 1 px.
Move one unaffected opening center by more than 1 px.
Remove one unaffected room adjacency edge.
